discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators (the quantum spin Hall effect)
subfield: Condensed matter physics / topological quantum matter
motivation: Kane and Mele (2005) showed that spin-orbit coupling can turn a time-reversal-invariant insulator into a new state of matter: one with a Z2 topological invariant and helical edge states that are protected from backscattering. This result took topological band theory beyond the quantum Hall effect and its magnetic fields. In 2007 Molenkamp's group observed quantized edge conductance in HgTe quantum wells, the first experimental realization of the quantum spin Hall insulator, and later demonstrated nonlocal helical transport. Together these works founded the field of topological insulators. That field now covers three-dimensional materials, topological superconductivity and Josephson junctions, and Majorana-based proposals for robust quantum technologies. It is a rare case where a deep, unifying concept was verified directly in mesoscopic transport, and it has reshaped condensed matter physics worldwide. Shoucheng Zhang, a co-originator of the HgTe proposal, has unfortunately died.
